verses.sloka: राघवस्त्वथ यातेषु तपस्विषु विचिन्तयन् ।न तत्रारोचयद्वासं कारणैर्बहुभिस्तदा ॥ २.११७.१॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavastvatha yāteṣu tapasviṣu vicintayan ।na tatrārocayadvāsaṁ kāraṇairbahubhistadā ॥ 2.117.1॥

translations.english: When the ascetics had departed, Rama thought over the matter well and did not like to reside there for many reasons.
translations.hindi: अयोध्यांकाएड का एक सो ग्यारहवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । lO} इादशोत्तरशततमः सग: तमग्रतिमतेजोम्यां आतृभ्यां रोमहषेणम्‌ ~ ‘~ __ ७ 0 बिस्मितः सङ्गमं प्रेत्य समंवेता महषयः

verses.sloka: इह मे भरतो दृष्टो मातरश्च सनागरा: ।सा च मे स्मृतिरन्वेति तान्नित्यमनुशोचत: ॥ २.११७.२॥
verses.transliteration: iha me bharato dṛṣṭo mātaraśca sanāgarā: ।sā ca me smṛtiranveti tānnityamanuśocata: ॥ 2.117.2॥

translations.english: It is here that Bharata, mothers along with citizens of Ayodhya have visited me. That memory soaked with grief is chasing me.
translations.hindi: पहले जो राजर्षिगण, सिद्धाण और देवषिंगण अन्तर्धान थे, वे इन दोनों भाइयों की प्रशंसा कर कहने लगे

verses.sloka: स्कन्धावारनिवेशेन तेन तस्य महात्मन: ।हयहस्तिकरीषैश्च उपमर्द्द: कृतो भृशम् ॥ २.११७.३॥
verses.transliteration: skandhāvāraniveśena tena tasya mahātmana: ।hayahastikarīṣaiśca upamardda: kṛto bhṛśam ॥ 2.117.3॥

translations.english: Due to the encampment of the army of the magnanimous Bharata (here), this place has been filled with the dung of horses and elephants and made exceedingly dirty.
translations.hindi: श्रन्ति ताः-पू्वमेबान्तर्धानं प्रासाः । (गो०) २ शऋृषिगणा -- राजर्धिंगणाः | ( गो० ) ३ परमर्षयः देवर्षयः । (गो०) ४ घर्म विक्रमौ- _ घर्मश्रौ। ५ स्पृह्महे-पुनः पुनःभोतु वांछामः । ( शि० ) १०५२ अयोध्याकाण्डे लोगों की यह इच्छा हो रही हे कि, इनन्रोतों को वातालप हम गर वार सुना दर

verses.sloka: तस्मादन्यत्र गच्छाम इति सञ्चिन्त्य राघव: ।प्रातिष्ठत स वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च सङ्गत: ॥ २.११७.४॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādanyatra gacchāma iti sañcintya rāghava: ।prātiṣṭhata sa vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca saṅgata: ॥ 2.117.4॥

translations.english: We shall, therefore, go to some other place, having resolved thus, Rama accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana set forth.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी- श्रीराम तथा भरत ने अपने अपने पक्ष समथन में जो युक्तियाँ दीं--वे दोनों की युक्ति युक्त थीं । तिश पर भी भरत को अपना पक्ष त्यागः का वाध्य हना पड़ा इसका कारण ओर बतलाया गया है | तरत्वूषिगशाः च्िप्र दशग्रीववधैषिणः भरतं राजशादूलमित्यूचुः सङ्गताः वचः:

verses.sloka: सो ऽत्रेराश्रममासाद्य तं ववन्दे महायशा: ।तं चापि भगवानत्रि: पुत्रवत् प्रत्यपद्यत ॥ २.११७.५॥
verses.transliteration: so 'trerāśramamāsādya taṁ vavande mahāyaśā: ।taṁ cāpi bhagavānatri: putravat pratyapadyata ॥ 2.117.5॥

translations.english: Having reached the hermitage of the revered sage Atri, illustrious Rama prostrated before him and Atri also received him as his son.
translations.hindi: है अटल प्रतिज्ञा बाले ! हे शुभचरित्रयुक्त महायशास्वी भरत ठुमने कुल्लीनकुल में जन्म लिआ है । यदि तुस अपने पिता.को !खी करना चाहते हो, तो तुम्हें बही करना उचित है, जो ।ीगासचन्द्र जी तुमसे कहते हैं

verses.sloka: स्वयमातिथ्यमादिश्य सर्वमस्य सुसत्कृतम् ।सौमित्रिं च महाभागां सीतां च समसान्त्वयत् ॥ २.११७.६॥
verses.transliteration: svayamātithyamādiśya sarvamasya susatkṛtam ।saumitriṁ ca mahābhāgāṁ sītāṁ ca samasāntvayat ॥ 2.117.6॥

translations.english: That sage Atri himself extended to Rama the hospitality befitting him in all possible ways and treated Lakshmana and highly virtuous Sita with kind words.
translations.hindi: दम सव यही चाहते हें कि श्रीराम अपने पिता के ऋण से क्ण हों । ( क्योंकि ) केकेयी के ऋण से उऋण होने से महाराज दशरथ स्वगवासी हुए हैं

verses.sloka: पत्नीं च समनुप्राप्तां वृद्धामामन्त्र्य सत्कृताम् ।सान्त्वयामास धर्मज्ञ: सर्वभूतहिते रत: ॥ २.११७.७॥
verses.transliteration: patnīṁ ca samanuprāptāṁ vṛddhāmāmantrya satkṛtām ।sāntvayāmāsa dharmajña: sarvabhūtahite rata: ॥ 2.117.7॥

translations.english: Conversant in the ways of righteousness and eagaged in the welfate of all beings, sage Atri called out his aged wife who is revered by all and spoke kind words to her.

verses.sloka: अनसूयां महाभागां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम् ।प्रतिगृह्णीष्व वैदेहीमब्रवीदृषिसत्तम: ।रामाय चाचचक्षे तां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम् ॥ २.११७.८॥
verses.transliteration: anasūyāṁ mahābhāgāṁ tāpasīṁ dharmacāriṇīm ।pratigṛhṇīṣva vaidehīmabravīdṛṣisattama: ।rāmāya cācacakṣe tāṁ tāpasīṁ dharmacāriṇīm ॥ 2.117.8॥

translations.english: Atri, who was excellent among the sages said to his ascetic wife who was highly virtuous and an adherent of righteousness, Welcome Sita. Thereafter, he related to Rama a story about his asetic wife who follows the ways of righteousness.
translations.hindi: शुभदशन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन ऋषियों के इस कथन से पित हों, उनसे कहा कि, आपने भलो भाँति मेरा धर्म बचाया

verses.sloka: दशवर्षाण्यनावृष्ट्या दग्धे लोके निरन्तरम् ।यया मूलफले सृष्टे जाह्नवी च प्रवर्त्तिता ॥ २.११७.९॥
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣāṇyanāvṛṣṭyā dagdhe loke nirantaram ।yayā mūlaphale sṛṣṭe jāhnavī ca pravarttitā ॥ 2.117.9॥

translations.english: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.

verses.sloka: उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता नियमैश्चाप्यलङ्कृता ।दशवर्षसहस्राणि यया तप्तं महत्तप: ॥ २.११७.१०॥
verses.transliteration: ugreṇa tapasā yuktā niyamaiścāpyalaṅkṛtā ।daśavarṣasahasrāṇi yayā taptaṁ mahattapa: ॥ 2.117.10॥

translations.english: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.
translations.hindi: हे श्रीर हास: नार लन ध ९ ज्येष्ठ दै श्रीरामचन्द्र ! राज्यपरिपालन धम का ज्येष्ठ राजकुमार हो को अधिकार 'है---इस कुलप्रथा पर भली भाँति विचार कर, मेरी माता कौसल्या की प्रार्थना पूरी करनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: अनसूया व्रतै: स्नाता प्रत्यूहाश्च निवर्त्तिता: ।देवकार्यनिमित्तं च यया संत्वरमाणया ।दशरात्रं कृता रात्रि: सेयं मातेव ते ऽनघ ॥ २.११७.११॥
verses.transliteration: anasūyā vratai: snātā pratyūhāśca nivarttitā: ।devakāryanimittaṁ ca yayā saṁtvaramāṇayā ।daśarātraṁ kṛtā rātri: seyaṁ māteva te 'nagha ॥ 2.117.11॥

translations.english: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.
translations.hindi: इस बड़े राज्य की अकेले रक्षा करने का ओर आपमें अनु- राग रखने वाले इन परवासियों तथा जनपदवासियोंका मनो- रञ्च करने का मुझे साहस नहीं होता

verses.sloka: तामिमां सर्वभूतानां नमस्कार्य्यां यशस्विनीम् ।अभिगच्छतु वैदेही वृद्धामक्रोधनां सदा ।अनसूयेति या लोके कर्मभि: ख्यातिमागता ॥ २.११७.१२॥
verses.transliteration: tāmimāṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ namaskāryyāṁ yaśasvinīm ।abhigacchatu vaidehī vṛddhāmakrodhanāṁ sadā ।anasūyeti yā loke karmabhi: khyātimāgatā ॥ 2.117.12॥

translations.english: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and selfimposed religious observances. She practised severe asceticism for ten thousand years bathed in her vows. Solicited on behalf of the gods, she removed all impediments and converted ten nights into one. She is like a your mother to you.
translations.hindi: अभ्यपूजयत्‌--सम्यड्मॉण्मंतोरक्षितवन्तः । (रा०) २ मममाठुः - ~ कौशल्याया। (रा०) ३ रक्तान्‌--त्वद्विपयकानुरागविशिष्टान्‌। (शि०) है ॥ वा? राई लल १०७७ अयोध्याकाण्डे ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राशि सुहृदश्च न; । त्वामेव प्रतिकाङचन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षकाः

verses.sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं तमृषिं तथेत्युक्त्वा स राघव: ।सीतामुवाच धर्मज्ञामिदं वचनमुत्तमम् ॥ २.११७.१३॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ tamṛṣiṁ tathetyuktvā sa rāghava: ।sītāmuvāca dharmajñāmidaṁ vacanamuttamam ॥ 2.117.13॥

translations.english: 'She is renowned throughout this world for her deeds as Anasuya, (one who is free from anger). Aged, illustrious she is free frm anger, worthy of adoration by all beings. Let Sita approach her'.
translations.hindi: अतएव हे बुद्धिमान्‌ ! तुम इस राज्य को अहण करो और जिसको चाहो उसे राजतिंहासन पर बिठा दो क्योंकि राज्य" शासन करने को, हे काकुत्स्थ”! तुम्हीं समथ हो

verses.sloka: राजपुत्रि श्रुतं त्वेतन्मुनेरस्य समीरितम् ।श्रेयोर्थमात्मन: श्रीघ्रमभिगच्छ तपस्विनीम् ॥ २.११७.१४॥
verses.transliteration: rājaputri śrutaṁ tvetanmunerasya samīritam ।śreyorthamātmana: śrīghramabhigaccha tapasvinīm ॥ 2.117.14॥

translations.english: Hearing those words of the sage, Rama said be it so and said to righteous Sita these choice words.
translations.hindi: यह कह कर भरत जी अपने भाई श्रीराम के चरणों में गिर ~ ९ करने पड़े और हे राम ! हे राम ! कहते हुए वार वार प्राथना करने लगे

verses.sloka: सीता त्वेतद्वच: श्रुत्वा राघवस्य हितैषिण: ।तामत्रिपत्नीं धर्मज्ञामभिचक्राम मैथिली ॥ २.११७.१५॥
verses.transliteration: sītā tvetadvaca: śrutvā rāghavasya hitaiṣiṇa: ।tāmatripatnīṁ dharmajñāmabhicakrāma maithilī ॥ 2.117.15॥

translations.english: O princess, you have heard the message of the sage. Without delay approach the ascetic (Anasuya) for your welfare.
translations.hindi: जाति बिरादरी वाले, सैनिक इष्टमित्र-सब के सब,जल बरसाने वाले मेघ के लिए उत्सुक किसान की तरह, एकमात्र तुम्हारे ही राज्यशासन की प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: शिथिलां वलितां वृद्धां जरापाण्डरमूर्द्धजाम् ।सततं वेपमानाङ्गी प्रवाते कदली यथा ॥ २.११७.१६॥
verses.transliteration: śithilāṁ valitāṁ vṛddhāṁ jarāpāṇḍaramūrddhajām ।satataṁ vepamānāṅgī pravāte kadalī yathā ॥ 2.117.16॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, intended for her welfare, Sita, daughter of the king of Mithila, approached the consort of Atri (Devi Anasuya), knower of righteousness, and reverently circumambulated her.
translations.hindi: मेरे बजवास के बिरुद्ध और राज्यशासन स्वीकार कर किसी को -राजसिंहासन पर विठा देने की बात जो तुमने कही, वह स्वाभाविक और गुरु द्वारा शिक्षा प्राप्तं होने का फल स्वरूप है । अतः ( इससे स्पष्ट है क्रि) तुम भली माँति राज्य रासन कर सकते हो । ( अर्थात तुम्हारी ऐसी सुन्दर बुद्धि का होना ही तुभे सुशासन की योग्यता के होने का प्रमाण है)

verses.sloka: तां तु सीता महाभागामनसूयां पतिव्रताम् ।अभ्यवादयदव्यग्रा स्वनाम समुदाहरत् ॥ २.११७.१७॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tu sītā mahābhāgāmanasūyāṁ pativratām ।abhyavādayadavyagrā svanāma samudāharat ॥ 2.117.17॥

translations.english: Highly chaste and fortunate Anasuya was very old and feeble. Her skin was wrinkled and her hair turned grey due to old age. Her body was constantly trembling like a plantain tree in a stormy wind. Pronouncing her name to such Anasuya, Sita made obeisance to her with utmost concentration.

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य च वैदेही तापसीं तामनिन्दिताम् ।बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम् ॥ २.११७.१८॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya ca vaidehī tāpasīṁ tāmaninditām ।baddhāñjalipuṭā hṛṣṭā paryapṛcchadanāmayam ॥ 2.117.18॥

translations.english: Highly chaste and fortunate Anasuya was very old and feeble. Her skin was wrinkled and her hair turned grey due to old age. Her body was constantly trembling like a plantain tree in a stormy wind. Pronouncing her name to such Anasuya, Sita made obeisance to her with utmost concentration.
translations.hindi: चन्द्रमा की शोभा चन्द्रमा को भले ही छोड़ दे, हिमालय अन्ने ही हिम को छोड़ दे। भले ही समुद्र अपनी सीमा को नाँघ जाय, किन्तु मैं पिता से की हुई अपनी प्रतिज्ञा को नहीं छोड़ सकवा

verses.sloka: तत: सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम् ।सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद्धृष्टा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे ॥ २.११७.१९॥
verses.transliteration: tata: sītāṁ mahābhāgāṁ dṛṣṭvā tāṁ dharmacāriṇīm ।sāntvayantyabravīddhṛṣṭā diṣṭyā dharmamavekṣase ॥ 2.117.19॥

translations.english: Sita offered her obeisance to the blameless ascetic, Anasuya, folding her palms and enquired of her wellbeing in delight.

verses.sloka: त्यक्त्वा ज्ञातिजनं सीते मानमृद्धिं च भामिनि ।अवरुद्धं वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमनुगच्छसि ॥ २.११७.२०॥
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā jñātijanaṁ sīte mānamṛddhiṁ ca bhāmini ।avaruddhaṁ vane rāmaṁ diṣṭyā tvamanugacchasi ॥ 2.117.20॥

translations.english: Anasuya was delighted to see the glorious Sita who was always engaged in righteous acts and said in kind words, You are fortunate. You are observing your rightful duty.
translations.hindi: जव श्रीराम ने ऐसा कहा तत्र तेज में सूर्य के,समान अथवा प्रतिपदा के चन्द्रमा की तरह प्रियदर्शन, कोसस्यानन्दन से भरत जी कहने लगे

verses.sloka: नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा पापो वा यदि वा शुभ: ।यासां स्त्रीणां प्रियो भर्ता तासां लोका महोदया: ॥ २.११७.२१॥
verses.transliteration: nagarastho vanastho vā pāpo vā yadi vā śubha: ।yāsāṁ strīṇāṁ priyo bhartā tāsāṁ lokā mahodayā: ॥ 2.117.21॥

translations.english: O noble Sita, by the grace of heaven you are following Rama, forsaking your kinsmen and wealth and confining yourself to the forest.

verses.sloka: दु:शील: कामवृत्तो वा धनैवा परिवर्जित: ।स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानां परमं दैवतं पति: ॥ २.११७.२२॥
verses.transliteration: du:śīla: kāmavṛtto vā dhanaivā parivarjita: ।strīṇāmāryasvabhāvānāṁ paramaṁ daivataṁ pati: ॥ 2.117.22॥

translations.english: One who is devoted to her husband, whether he be in the city or in the forest, whether he is sinful or virtuous, will attain the most prosperous worlds.

verses.sloka: नातो विशिष्टं पश्यामि बान्धवं विमृशन्त्यहम् ।सर्वत्रयोग्यं वैदेहि तप:कृतमिवाव्ययम् ॥ २.११७.२३॥
verses.transliteration: nāto viśiṣṭaṁ paśyāmi bāndhavaṁ vimṛśantyaham ।sarvatrayogyaṁ vaidehi tapa:kṛtamivāvyayam ॥ 2.117.23॥

translations.english: For a woman of noble nature her husband, whether he be licentious or of bad character or devoid of riches, is her supreme lord.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--इससे जान पड़ता है कि खड़ाऊँ के और भी जोड़े भरत जी अयोध्या से अपने साथ लाए थे | इसीको एक बार श्रीराम के चरणों में पहना था | स पाढुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत्‌ । चतुदंश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्यहम्‌

verses.sloka: न त्वेनमवगच्छन्ति गुणदोषमसत्स्त्रिय: ।कामवक्तव्यहृदया भर्तृनाथा श्चरन्ति या: ॥ २.११७.२४॥
verses.transliteration: na tvenamavagacchanti guṇadoṣamasatstriya: ।kāmavaktavyahṛdayā bhartṛnāthā ścaranti yā: ॥ 2.117.24॥

translations.english: O Sita, on reflection I know of none who is a better friend than the husband. He, like an imperishable penance, once acquired is never lost.

verses.sloka: प्राप्नुवन्त्ययशश्चैव धर्मभ्रंशं च मैथिलि ।अकार्यवशमापन्ना: स्त्रियो या: खलु तद्विधा: ॥ २.११७.२५॥
verses.transliteration: prāpnuvantyayaśaścaiva dharmabhraṁśaṁ ca maithili ।akāryavaśamāpannā: striyo yā: khalu tadvidhā: ॥ 2.117.25॥

translations.english: Those wicked women whose minds are overpowered by carnal desires, ranging at will as lords of their husbands, do not understand about vice and virtue.
translations.hindi: हे परन्तप ! सव राजकाय तुम्हारी खड़ाउओं को अपण कर, (सैं राज्य का प्रबन्ध करता रहूंगा परन्तु ) जिस दिन चौदहवाँ वषं पूरा होगा उस दिन भी यदि तुमको मैंने अयोध्या मैं न देखा, तो मैं अग्नि में गिर कर, भस्म हो जाऊँगा

verses.sloka: त्वद्विधास्तु गुणैर्युक्ता दृष्टलोकपरावरा: ।स्त्रिय: स्वग चरिष्यन्ति यथा धर्मकृतस्तथा ॥ २.११७.२६॥
verses.transliteration: tvadvidhāstu guṇairyuktā dṛṣṭalokaparāvarā: ।striya: svaga cariṣyanti yathā dharmakṛtastathā ॥ 2.117.26॥

translations.english: O Sita, those women under the control of unworthy acts are dislodged from the path of righteousness and get infamy.
translations.hindi: भरत की इस बात को सुन श्रीराम ने “तथास्तु” ( ऐसा ह्वी गा) कह कर ( चौदहवाँ वष पूर्ण होते ही लोट कर था जाने की ) प्रतिज्ञा की और “भरत को आदर पूवक हृदय से लगाया

verses.sloka: तदेवमेनं त्वमनुव्रता सती पतिव्रतानां समयानुवर्तिनी ।भवस्व भर्त्तु: सहधर्मचारिणी यशश्च धर्मं च तत: समाप्स्यसि ॥ २.११७.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadevamenaṁ tvamanuvratā satī pativratānāṁ samayānuvartinī ।bhavasva bharttu: sahadharmacāriṇī yaśaśca dharmaṁ ca tata: samāpsyasi ॥ 2.117.27 ॥

translations.english: Women like you who are endowed with virtues and can distinguish between good and bad in this world, like those who perform virtuous deeds, will move about in heaven.
